name: Yuukoku no Femme Fatale
original_name: 悠刻のファムファタル
source:
[b][i]A Mansion Home to Enigmatic "Beautiful Girls" — Femme Fatales[/i][/b]

"Kouyoukan" (Maple Manor) stands secluded in the mountains, housing four devoted maids.

The young author, Kusakabe Akira, stumbled upon this mysterious abode by chance, or so it seemed.

He came to drop off a letter from his late grandmother. But the head maid had other plans, handing him two unexpected assignments.

[b]First, to stay as a "guest."
Second, to pen a story set within these walls.[/b]

Caught in a creative rut, Akira agrees to the terms and becomes a temporary resident.
He encounters four maidens, each bearing the name of a flower.

Life at the mansion unfolds leisurely, shadowed by underlying secrets.
What discoveries and insights will Akira gain during his stay?

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/world.html#world_01]official website[/url]]
translation:
[b][i]神秘“美少女”之家——蛇蝎美人[/i][/b]

“红枫馆”矗立在深山之中，住着四名忠诚的女仆。

年轻作家日下部彰偶然发现了这个神秘的住所，或者看起来是这样。

他来是为了送一封已故祖母的信。但女仆长另有打算，交给了他两项意想不到的任务。

[b]首先，以“客人”身份留下来。
其次，写一个以这些墙壁为背景的故事。[/b]

阿基拉陷入创作困境，同意条款并成为临时居民。
他遇到了四个少女，每个少女都有一朵花的名字。

豪宅里的生活悠闲地展开，隐藏着潜在的秘密。
在此期间，阿基拉将会获得哪些发现和感悟？

[翻译和编辑自[url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/world.html#world_01]官方网站[/url]]
